lang.description: BCP 47 code of this translation (e.g. pt-BR). Not shown to users; do not translate.

extName.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store and extensions page. Keep "YouClip" and "YouTube" as is.

extDescription.message: Share YouTube links that start and stop at the exact moments you pick.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and extensions page.

actionTitle.message: Share a clip of this video

shareClip.description: Heading of the clip picker (in the YouTube Share dialog and the popup).

start.description: Label above the clip start time field.

end.description: Label above the clip end time field.

startTimeLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the start time field.

endTimeLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the end time field.

now.description: Short button that fills in the current playback time.

preview.description: Button that plays the clip so the sharer can check it.

previewTooltip.message: Play the clip to check it

copy.description: Short button that copies the clip link (YouTube Share dialog).

copyClipLink.description: Button that copies the clip link (popup).

copied.description: Shown on the copy button right after copying.

copyFailed.description: Shown on the copy button when copying did not work.

clipLinkLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the field that shows the clip link.

clipTitle.description: Label above the optional clip title field. The title is shown on the clip’s web page (Link for everyone).

clipTitlePlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the clip title field, saying it can be left empty.

clipLength.description: Length of the selected clip, e.g. "0:30 long".

stopHint.message: The video will stop at the selected end time with options to continue or replay the clip.
stopHint.description: Note under the clip picker explaining what viewers of the link will see.

errorStartInvalid.message: Enter a valid start time, like 1:23.
errorStartInvalid.description: Error when the start time cannot be read. Keep the example time 1:23.

errorEndInvalid.message: Enter a valid end time, like 2:45.
errorEndInvalid.description: Error when the end time cannot be read. Keep the example time 2:45.

errorEndBeforeStart.message: The end time must be after the start time.
errorEndBeforeStart.description: Error when the end time is not after the start time.

errorStartPastVideo.message: The start time is past the end of the video ($DURATION$).
errorStartPastVideo.description: Error when the start time is after the video ends.

errorEndPastVideo.message: The end time is past the end of the video ($DURATION$).
errorEndPastVideo.description: Error when the end time is after the video ends.

badgeLabel.description: Label on the video player while a clip plays, e.g. "Clip 1:23 – 2:00".

badgeTooltip.message: This link is a clip: the video pauses at the end time
badgeTooltip.description: Tooltip of the label on the video player while a clip plays.

badgeCloseTooltip.description: Tooltip of the ✕ button that turns clip mode off.

badgeCloseLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the ✕ button that turns clip mode off.

clipEnded.description: Heading shown over the video when the clip reaches its end time.

replayClip.description: Button that plays the clip again from its start.

keepWatching.description: Button that continues watching the rest of the video after the clip ended.

popupTip.message: Tip: leave this open while the video plays and press $NOW$ at the start and end moments.
popupTip.description: Tip in the popup. $NOW$ is replaced with the bold "Now" button label.

msgOpenVideo.message: Open a YouTube video to share a clip of it.
msgOpenVideo.description: Popup message when the current tab is not a YouTube video.

msgReloadTab.message: Reload this YouTube tab so YouClip can connect to it.
msgReloadTab.description: Popup message when the YouTube tab was open before the extension was installed or updated.

msgLostConnection.message: Lost connection to the YouTube tab. Reload it and try again.
msgLostConnection.description: Popup message when the YouTube tab stopped responding.

linkTypeLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the switch between the two kinds of clip link.

linkEveryone.description: Option: a link to the YouClip web page (youclip.ca), which plays the clip for anyone without the extension.

linkYouTube.description: Option: a regular youtube.com link (stops at the end time only for people with the extension).

everyoneHint.message: Opens a page that plays just this clip, on any device, even without YouClip.
everyoneHint.description: Note under the picker when "Link for everyone" is selected.

watchOnYouTube.description: Link/button on the web player that opens the video on youtube.com.

siteInvalidLink.message: This clip link is incomplete or broken. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
siteInvalidLink.description: Web player message when the link is missing the video or the times.

siteCantEmbed.message: This video can’t be played here.
siteCantEmbed.description: Web player message when YouTube does not allow the video to play outside youtube.com.

clipButton.description: Label of the Clip button added next to Like/Share under the video. Keep it short (one word if possible).

close.description: Screen-reader label and tooltip of the ✕ button that closes the clip picker.

cancelPreview.description: Button shown only while a preview plays. Stops the preview.

cancelPreviewTooltip.message: Stop the preview and go back to where you were in the video
cancelPreviewTooltip.description: Tooltip of the Cancel preview button.
